Market today: The mood is cautious, especially in tech and chips. A deepening chip sell-off in Asia and warnings about tech valuations are the real drivers, directly impacting your concentrated portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL is down nearly 50% and SPAL is down 56.9%; both are leveraged and decaying, amplifying losses on margin. QQQ and QQQI are also showing "SELL" status and are close to their stops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your QQQ and QQQI stops, and be ready to act on SMH if the chip sell-off continues.

Bottom line: Your heavy tech/chip concentration and leveraged positions are under pressure; managing risk is paramount.
plays: QQQ: Respect the 670 stop. If it breaks, trim or exit to protect capital.
SOXL: Re-evaluate your stop for this leveraged, decaying ETF. A 49.65% loss is significant.
SMH: Watch the 540 stop closely. The chip sell-off could push it lower.
